## What We Did

<!-- CHANGE THIS: replace with your own notes -->


Today in class, our class made a repository from a template made by Prof. Delmelle. During class, I cloned my repository to GitHub Desktop and then opened and edited the files in RStudio. I edited the index markdown file which was a Quarto file. We went through the process of creating the website, as well as committing and pushing those changes onto github.com. Now I am editing the Week 1 Quarto markdown file with this text that you are reading now.

## Key Concepts

Three places a file can live:

1. **My computer** — where I edit
2. **GitHub.com** — where it's stored
3. **My live site** — what the world sees

The loop: **Edit → Save → Render → Commit → Push → wait → refresh**

## Proving R Works

The chunk below runs when this page renders. If you can see a result underneath
it on your published site, R and Quarto are talking to each other correctly.

```{r}
sessionInfo()$R.version$version.string
```
